name: tree-sitter-conformant
description: Tree-sitter grammar for the Conformant schema language

scripts.test:schemas: find "${CONFORMANT_SCHEMAS:?Set CONFORMANT_SCHEMAS to a directory of schemas}" -type f \( -name '*.conformant' -o -name '*.plato' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec tree-sitter parse -p . -q -- {} +
